AI Overview
Quordle
Video game
Quordle is a browser-based, single-player word-guessing game where players simultaneously solve four five-letter word grids within nine turns. 
Merriam-Webster
 +1
Gameplay and Rules
Multiple Grids: Each guess you type is entered into all active word quadrants at the same time. 
YouTube
·Triple S Games
 +1
Color Feedback: Standard color-coding applies—green means the letter is correct and in the right spot, yellow means it is in the word but the wrong spot, and gray means it is absent. 
Wikipedia
Completion: Once a specific word grid is solved, no further guesses apply to it, and your focus shifts to the remaining open grids. 
YouTube
·Triple S Games
 +1
Winning: You win by successfully solving all four target words within your allotted nine guesses.

·Triple S Games

Game Modes
Classic: The standard mode giving you 9 guesses to find 4 words.
Extreme: Features unusual target words with 8 guesses.
Chill: Gives 12 guesses for less unusual words.
Sequence: Requires you to solve the four words sequentially one at a time.
Practice: An endless mode allowing you to play as many unranked games as you want.
